title: AI Superpowers Newsletter Explainer (one-shot HTML)
summary: A 34 s silent, very simple explainer for a free newsletter, shown as made from a single Claude prompt (the opening is a screen capture of the prompt being typed). It then plays the result: pale-blue canvas, centred bold headline 'A new AI tool drops every day.' with blue second line 'Nobody has time to test them all.' and floating 'New model / New app / New agent' pills, a lightning-bolt icon and 'Meet AI Superpowers.', a 3-step HOW IT WORKS row of white cards with yellow numbered badges, a counting subscriber stat, and a logo end card. Clean but basic, template-like.
fit_reason: Exactly the plain, light, step-by-step structure SaaSSuite needs (problem → product → 3 steps → proof → CTA) and in light blue + yellow, but motion is basic fades; good baseline, not a ceiling.

palette.mood: light airy pale-blue with mid-blue text accent and yellow badges

typography.size_behaviour: medium centred headline + blue subline; big stat numerals
typography.notes: Tracked blue caps eyebrow 'HOW IT WORKS'. Full stops on every line. Blue for secondary lines and taglines.

text_animation: second line fades in after first in blue
motion: floating label pills drift/bob around headline
icon tile rotates slightly and settles
step cards fade/scale in one by one with numbered badges
transitions: cut from prompt capture to output
graphic_elements: blue rounded-square app icon with yellow bolt
white step cards with line icons (envelope, bolt, check) and yellow number badges
ui_treatment: Opening: real Claude chat UI screen recording of the prompt; rest has no product UI.
signature_moves: show the one-shot prompt first, then the result
floating 'New model / New app' pills around the problem line
3-step HOW IT WORKS cards with yellow number badges

best_segments.what: Problem headline + blue subline with floating 'New ...' pills
HOW IT WORKS: three step cards appear one by one with yellow badges
Subscriber counter rolls to 2,000+ with credibility line

recreate.how: Single HTML page with CSS/GSAP timeline, recorded with Puppeteer/ffmpeg; or Remotion. No assets needed beyond icons.
recreate.prompt: Light pale-blue 30 s newsletter explainer: centred bold problem line with blue second line and floating 'New model/New app' pills, an icon + 'Meet <product>.', three white step cards with yellow number badges, a counting subscriber stat, logo end card.
